SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
  min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
  sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_gross,
  sum(gross_amount) AS gross
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-10'

SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS from_sep, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, f.channel_code, count(*) AS n,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch,
  sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount, s.store_id, (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_web_matched, f.channel_code
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT s.region, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) AS aug_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) AS sep_2024,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE store_id=900 AND NOT is_web_matched AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30') AS web_unmatched
FROM lines s
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
mine AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS d, s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT business_date AS d, store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', coalesce(m.d, c.d)) AS mth,
  SUM(coalesce(m.net,0)) AS mine, SUM(coalesce(c.net,0)) AS control,
  SUM(coalesce(m.net,0)-coalesce(c.net,0)) AS gap,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(coalesce(m.net,0)-coalesce(c.net,0))>0.05) AS bad_store_days
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.d=c.d AND m.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE coalesce(m.d, c.d) BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.region, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores, min(s.valid_from) AS vf, max(s.valid_to) AS vt, count(*) AS lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outside_validity,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id IN (101,102,103,104,105,114) THEN s.store_id END) AS reorg_stores,
  string_agg(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id IN (101,102,103,104,105,114) THEN CAST(s.store_id AS VARCHAR) END, ',') AS reorg_ids
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<>999
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, f.gross_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT region,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS aug_2024_gross_incl_vat,
       SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sep_2024_gross_incl_vat
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region
